act_name: West Pakistan Government Dues Recovery Ordinance, 1962
heading: Short title, extend and commencement
title: Short title, extend and commencement
text:
1. Short title, extend and commencement. (1) This Ordinance may be called the West Pakistan Government Dues Recovery Ordinance, 1962.
(2) It extends to the whole of the Province of West Pakistan except the Tribal Areas.
(3) It shall come into force at once.

heading: In this Ordinance, unless the context otherwise requires, the following expressions shall
title: In this Ordinance, unless the context otherwise requires, the following expressions shall
text:
2. In this Ordinance, unless the context otherwise requires, the following expressions shall have the meanings hereby respectively assigned to them, that is to say__
(a) “defaulter” means a person from whom any dues are recoverable by Government, and includes a person who is responsible as surety for the payment of any such dues; and
(b) “Government” means the Government of the Province of West Pakistan.

2.  In this Ordinance, unless the context otherwise requires, the following expressions shall 
have the meanings hereby respectively assigned to them, that is to say__ 
(a) 
“defaulter” means a person from whom any dues are recoverable by

heading: (1) Government may, by notification, declare that any dues or class of dues recoverable by
title: (1) Government may, by notification, declare that any dues or class of dues recoverable by
text:
3. (1) Government may, by notification, declare that any dues or class of dues recoverable by Government shall be recoverable from the defaulters as if such dues were arrears of land revenue.
(2) On the publication of a notification under sub-section (1) any such dues shall be recoverable under the Revenue Recoveries Act, 1890 (Act I of 1890) as arrears of land revenue.
raw_text:
3. (1) Government may, by notification, declare that any dues or class of dues recoverable by
